S.O. 849(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (3) of section 1 of the Bharatiya
Sakshya Adhiniyam, 2023 (47 of 2023), the Central Government hereby appoints the 1st day of July, 2024
as the date on which the provisions of the said Adhiniyam, shall come into force.
